usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a clear, coherently cited picture of the Skanska executive: identity, education, and a stepwise career (joined 1991, Skanska Sweden head 2008, group management 2013, Deputy CEO, CEO since 2018), each backed by a verbatim Swedish Wikipedia quote. All six dossier statements are supported by their cited passages; no overclaims (the known traps — the Migration Agency namesake, company-scale figures, employer award) do not appear in any dossier statement. Remaining questions: the dossier never states what it omits (family, board roles, current status beyond 2018 start, strategy/views), and rests on a single source (Swedish Wikipedia, one article, completeness 'partial'), so completeness is implicitly over-implied rather than explicitly qualified. Conversation readiness is moderate: a reader knows his roles and timeline but has no information on current priorities, personality, or recent developments; single-source coverage limits meeting prep.
